annotations.text:
Flow: Board (kanban + New from idea) -> live progress -> approve the publish -> diff review -> Push & open PR.
SimpleMode is the tray-badge ticket drafted in New from idea, seen by the non-developer who filed it — deliberately no sidebar.

ApprovalPrompt = the HIGH-risk treatment only (publish gate; always an OS notification, mandatory reject reason, no Undo, no auto-allow).
MEDIUM is the compact inline card and LOW the passive line — both in TicketDetail's stream. The cumulative-risk strip in TicketDetail's rail promotes the next MEDIUM to HIGH.

TicketDetail: use the "Needs you" switch to see #94 (in flight, click the stepper for phases), #108 pipenzo:awaiting-stack-approval, #113 pipenzo:needs-pre-scoping, #85 ci-failed, #87 with its activity stream still loading (id, stepper and rail come from the ticket store and render at once; only the stream replay is late).
Steer / Stop live under the stepper on #94's Refine, Implement and Review steps — not on Approve, where the run has already stopped. Stop asks first and keeps the commits. Approving the publish gate ends with the human-gated lesson prompt at the foot of the stream.

Board: Working shows bounded concurrency (2 of 2 running, a held card with the file overlap, an approved stack as a container card). Both diff-gate outcomes land in Needs human, next to #92 pipenzo:interrupted and #101 pipenzo:merge-conflict — the second PR-event reaction, which parks here rather than in Ready for review because nothing has been attempted yet. The sync pill's refresh steps through its three renderings: synced, syncing, syncing slowly.
Click the ⌘K field for the command palette and the workspace row for the connected-repos menu.

DiffReview: the right rail runs in order of authority — machine-verified gates, agent-captured evidence, then reviewer findings by severity. Click a finding to mark the line it names in the diff on the left. Critical is the only severity that holds the push gate closed; this run has none, which is why the gate list still reads 5/5.

Row 3: the four screens the sidebar has pointed at since the first pass and that were never built.
Connect is pre-app — no sidebar, like SimpleMode — and carries both device-flow steps: the code, then the picker whose selection becomes the workspace connected-repos list every other screen reads from.
Activity is what makes "the board shows open work, the history lives here" real: #105 merged, so GitHub closed it and its card left the board on the next poll — its publish, its gates and its refused worktree cleanup all stay in this feed.
Models & gates splits what is editable from what is not: routing classes pick a tier, verify is fixed at or above the implementer, and the five deterministic gates are switches you can read but not move.

Foundations: "Loading, error and empty" is the section that covers what every other artboard skips — skeletons (one .sk shimmer primitive, flattened by the existing reduced-motion rule), pending buttons, the retrying vs blocking banner split, pipenzo:interrupted in both its resumable and non-resumable forms, the refused worktree cleanup, and the first-run and per-lane empties.
Newer sections: Popovers (.pop, .cmdk-panel, .ws-menu), live run controls, findings by severity, and lesson memory. The status-chip card states why there is no Done chip and no Done lane.
